question: What claim is made about the scope of the yoginī named Will and the authority by which it is known to the siddhas?
premises: A yoginī named Will is posited.
She is known by the siddhas.
Her scope extends up to Māyā and is by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī named Will is presented as extending up to Māyā, known by the siddhas, and operative by supreme will.
uncertainties: The precise relation between supreme will and her activity is not detailed here.
plain_english: The yoginī named Will, by the siddhas up to Māyā, is by supreme will.
